title: TSE Resolution No. 23.732/2024 amending the electoral propaganda rules on AI-generated content and deepfakes
title_original: Resolução TSE nº 23.732, de 27 de fevereiro de 2024 (altera a Resolução nº 23.610/2019)
summary: Resolution of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) adopted on 27 February 2024 for the 2024 municipal elections. It amended Resolution 23.610/2019 on electoral propaganda by adding rules on synthetic content made with AI (new Articles 9-B and 9-C): campaign material created or altered with AI must be explicitly labelled, and deepfakes used to harm or favour a candidacy are prohibited. The provisions remain part of Resolution 23.610, which was further amended for 2026 by Resolution 23.755/2026.
key_obligations: Label campaign content created or altered by AI
Do not use deepfakes to harm or favour a candidacy

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence and Democracy: Legal Analysis of the Use of Deepfake in the Electoral Context in Light of TRE-MA Jurisprudence
